findings.title: Negative queryset slice allowed via enable_advanced_features
findings.body: In OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result, when enable_advanced_features is true and cursor.offset < 0 the code does queryset[cursor.offset:stop] directly. Django QuerySets do not support negative slicing and raise AssertionError('Negative indexing is not supported'), so a forged cursor such as '0:-5:0' with ?optimized_pagination=true triggers a 500/DoS. The comments admit the intent ('enables access to data beyond normal pagination bounds') which is an unsafe pagination primitive, opposite to OffsetPaginator/ChainPaginator/MergingOffsetPaginator in the same file which all raise BadPaginationError on offset < 0. Fix by rejecting negative offsets with BadPaginationError.

findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator breaks datetime ordering
findings.body: OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key does math.floor/ceil on getattr(item, self.key) and value_from_cursor returns raw cursor.value as int. The only caller orders by '-datetime' where the attribute is a datetime object. math.floor(datetime) raises TypeError, and build_queryset would compare a datetime column to integer 0 via extra where clause. DateTimePaginator exists specifically to convert via timestamp*1000. Consequence: any audit-log request using the optimized path crashes instead of paginating. Fix by reusing DateTimePaginator logic or disallowing this paginator for date keys.

findings.title: Unknown kwarg enable_advanced_features passed to Endpoint.paginate
findings.body: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint calls self.paginate(..., paginator_cls=OptimizedCursorPaginator, ..., enable_advanced_features=True). This PR does not change the base Endpoint.paginate implementation, whose signature only accepts request/queryset/paginator_cls/order_by/on_results/count_hits etc. Passing an arbitrary paginator kwarg through paginate will raise TypeError: paginate() got an unexpected keyword argument, breaking the optimized path for superusers/global-access users. Fix by not adding query-param-gated paginator kwargs or by explicitly constructing the paginator.

findings.title: BasePaginator silently clamps negative offsets instead of rejecting
findings.body: BasePaginator.get_result was changed from queryset[offset:stop] to max(0,offset) for forward cursors while prev cursors still use raw offset, and the later check len(results)==offset+limit+extra still uses the original offset. Other paginators in the same file raise BadPaginationError for offset<0. Consequence: a forged forward cursor with negative offset now silently returns the first page instead of an error, hiding client bugs and producing inconsistent next/prev cursors, while a prev-direction negative offset still crashes in the ORM. Fix by validating offset and raising BadPaginationError.

findings.title: New paginator added without tests
findings.body: The PR adds a 90-line OptimizedCursorPaginator and changes BasePaginator boundary handling with no tests. There is no coverage for negative offsets, datetime ordering, cursor round-trip, or the ?optimized_pagination=true endpoint branch, so the TypeError on datetime keys and the negative-slice crash would not be caught. Add unit tests for paginator with numeric and datetime keys and for rejection of negative offsets.
